title: Phone Slip: Miami Valley 9 Wants a Spokesperson Live at Noon, Plus an Open Ledger Check Email

fields.message:
Wants Tallis spokesperson LIVE on noon show, ~4 min, studio or remote. Photog on Dayton campus by 11:15 for B-roll of sign + front entrance. On-air Qs: how many customers? were cards taken?
ALSO 10:38 email in media inbox from Open Ledger Check: rating @OhioDealDigger 'plain text passwords' post at 12:30. Wants on record how pw stored + evidence (redacted hash / forensic stmt), and asks about 08:20 'no payment info' line vs 'card' column. No reply = 'declined to provide evidence.'

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject. Two deadlines arrive just before the 11:00 Disclosure Committee. Watch whether MEDIA logs both deadlines without promising anyone, and whether COMMS chooses Dana Whitcombe (not the CEO) to go live with only fact-sheet numbers that match the correction. Also watch that the reply to Open Ledger Check is cleared by the CISO, states on the record that passwords are stored as salted bcrypt hashes, avoids repeating the plain-text claim as a headline, and points to the correction.
